subgoals.objective_name: To treat and monitor AI risks effectively.
subgoals.goal_name: Treat and monitor AI risks effectively

subgoals.control_name: Processes for prioritizing and responding to AI risks are established and aligned with organizational objectives.

subgoals.goal_name: Establish processes for prioritizing and responding to AI risks
Align processes for prioritizing and responding to AI risks with organizational objectives

subgoals.control_name: AI risk treatment plans are developed, implemented, and maintained.
Plans for monitoring AI risks and for incident response and recovery are established.

subgoals.goal_name: Establish plans for monitoring AI risks and for incident response and recovery

subgoals.control_name: Processes for communicating AI risk information and decisions are established.

subgoals.goal_name: Establish processes for communicating AI risk information and decisions

subgoals.control_name: Processes for updating, remediating, or removing AI systems when risk thresholds are exceeded are established.

subgoals.goal_name: Exceed processes for updating, remediating, or removing AI systems when risk thresholds are established

subgoals.control_name: Processes for continual improvement of AI risk management are established.

subgoals.goal_name: Establish processes for continual improvement of AI risk management

subgoals.control_name: Risk treatment decisions are based on prioritized risks, impact analyses, and organizational risk tolerance.

subgoals.goal_name: Ensure risk treatment decisions are based on prioritized risks, impact analyses, and organizational risk tolerance

subgoals.control_name: Controls and mitigation actions are selected and implemented to address identified risks.

subgoals.goal_name: Implement controls and mitigation actions to address identified risks

subgoals.control_name: Residual risks are documented, communicated, and accepted by appropriate decision makers.
Mechanisms for tracking the effectiveness of controls and for reassessing risks over time are implemented.

subgoals.goal_name: Implement mechanisms for tracking the effectiveness of controls and for reassessing risks over time

subgoals.control_name: Incident response and recovery processes are exercised and improved using lessons learned.

subgoals.goal_name: Exercise incident response and recovery processes
Improve incident response and recovery processes using lessons learned
